notes: pandapaxxy (PvE / M+KB / Controller): "A caster frame sword with Cold Steel? All 3 Icefall Mantle Titan’s rejoice! This allows you to stun champs from further away or just synergize with Stasis. What separates this from The Slammer or Zephyr is really just being a caster frame. Unrelenting is going to allow you to throw your heavy attack into a group of enemies, focus on another separate target and still get your health back. Tireless Blades or Relentless Strikes will give you back ammo depending on what you’re looking to do, boss damage or add clear." Recommended MW: Impact.

pandapaxxy (PvP / M+KB / Controller): "Over in PvP there’s potential with Valiant Charge allowing you to lunge further after blocking damage, but most players will still opt for Eager Edge. Assassin’s Blade will make you move faster after getting kills. Unfortunately you cannot combine the movement with an ammo regeneration perk, which really limits the capability of this sword." Recommended MW: Impact.

Inspired by @PodvsEnemies episode 106 from 3 July 2024 (https://open.spotify.com/episode/7jGtQ3pw94PV7XpXREQ094?si=ddb5fb64813048e1) with @Saint_Kabr, @ImpetusAlways and @CourtProjects (PvE / PvE-Boss / PvE-Champion / PvE-EndGame / PvE-God / M+KB / Controller): First-choice PvE pick for stunning Overload Champions. Shapeable. Ill Omen is the first Stasis Caster from sword that can drop Cold Steel - which is potentially exciting for being able to disrupt Overload champions from a distance... except at the point of reviewing this weapon, in practice it's very inconsistent. To keep or craft one in the hope this bug gets fixed, you'll want to maximise ammo rather than damage with the Blade perk. For the guard perk, Swordmaster's Guard adds a little bit to everything and then, although there's not much that pairs with Cold Steel projectile attacks in the first trait perk column, Unrelenting, Relentless Strikes or Tireless Blade might be occasionally useful. The Radiolaria Transposer origin trait is nice to have - the AoE damage isn't huge, but it is additional to weapon damage so what's not to like? Recommended MW: Impact, with a Backup Mag mod.

Adamsdown_Boy (PvE / PvE-MinorSpec / PvE-MajorSpec / PvE-EndGame / PvE-God / M+KB / Controller): PvE pick for add-clearing Minor enemies. Shapeable. Ill Omen is the first Stasis Caster from sword so potentially provides both CQC and occasional distance damage with a sword. For add-clearing, you'll want to maximise ammo rather than damage with the Blade perk. For the guard perk, Swordmaster's Guard adds a little bit to everything and then, in the first trait perk column, Tireless Blade and Relentless Strikes are useful for ammo economy or Unrelenting will keep your health topped up in CQC. In the second column, Surrounded or One For All are all good choices for increasing damage against chunkier adds. The Radiolaria Transposer origin trait is nice to have - the AoE damage isn't huge, but it is additional to weapon damage so what's not to like? Recommended MW: Impact, with a Backup Mag mod.
